integrity: The exact beta–Gaussian forward law and moments are acknowledged prior results. Analytical inversion and inequalities independently follow from strictly monotone scale-free cumulant ratio. Verification is finite and not an infinite proof. Strong implicit-corollary originality risk documented.
scientific_limitations: Fixed 1D harmonic trap with positive k,v,D,gamma, independent Brownian noise and symmetric telegraph switching. Only the dimensionless parameter ratios are recoverable from the exact stationary law. No finite-sample statistical stability or unknown measurement-noise identification.
title: Three-cumulant tomography and an exact feasibility boundary for trapped active particles
